entities.summary: Anton Lindholm is a Swedish ice hockey defenceman. He is currently playing under contract with SC Bern in the National League (NL). Lindholm was selected by the Colorado Avalanche in the 5th round, 144th overall, at the 2014 National Hockey League (NHL) Entry Draft.
